description: Modular records entitlements definitions referenced by records_entitlements in the unified pipeline registry. Each entry describes a type of record a person is legally entitled to obtain, the custodian, and the acquisition pathway.

records.label: Police Reports / Incident Reports
records.legal_basis: State public records act; victim rights statutes
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from records division of the responding police department. Victims are entitled to copies under most state victim rights laws.

records.label: Protection Orders / Restraining Orders
records.acquisition_pathway: Request certified copies from the court clerk's office where the order was filed.

records.label: Medical Records
records.acquisition_pathway: Submit written request to the healthcare provider's medical records department. HIPAA requires response within 30 days.

records.label: 911 Dispatch Logs / CAD Records
records.acquisition_pathway: File a public records request with the dispatch center or police department for Computer-Aided Dispatch (CAD) records.

records.label: Shelter Intake Records
records.legal_basis: Client right to own records; VAWA confidentiality provisions
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from the shelter or service provider. Note: VAWA protects shelter location confidentiality.

records.label: CPS Investigation Records
records.legal_basis: Party to case; state disclosure statutes
records.acquisition_pathway: Request as a party to the investigation. Access varies by state — some require court order.

records.label: Housing Inspection Reports
records.custodian: City/county code enforcement or health department
records.legal_basis: Municipal public records; state public records act
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from the code enforcement or building inspection division. Most are public record.

records.label: Lease / Rental Agreement
records.acquisition_pathway: Tenant is entitled to a copy of the signed lease. Request in writing from landlord.

records.label: Utility Records / Billing History
records.acquisition_pathway: Request billing history and service records from the utility company as the account holder.

records.label: Code Enforcement Complaint History
records.acquisition_pathway: File a public records request for complaint history on the specific property address.

records.label: Building Permits
records.acquisition_pathway: Search online permit database or request from the building department by property address.

records.label: Housing Court Filings
records.acquisition_pathway: Search court records by party name or case number. Request certified copies from the clerk.

records.label: Insurance Denial Letter
records.acquisition_pathway: Insurer is required to provide written denial with specific reasons and appeal rights.

records.label: Insurance Policy Documents
records.acquisition_pathway: Request complete policy including all endorsements, riders, and amendments from the insurer.

records.label: Claims History / CLUE Report
records.acquisition_pathway: Request claims history from insurer. Request CLUE report from LexisNexis (free annually under FCRA).

records.label: Internal Review / Utilization Review Notes
records.legal_basis: State insurance regulations; ERISA (for employer plans)
records.acquisition_pathway: Request the complete claim file including internal review notes. Many states require disclosure upon appeal.

records.label: Utilization Review Criteria
records.legal_basis: ACA transparency requirements; state insurance regulations
records.acquisition_pathway: Request the specific clinical criteria used to deny the claim. Insurers must disclose upon request.

records.label: Pay Stubs / Wage Statements
records.legal_basis: State wage statement laws (most states require)
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from employer's payroll department. Most states require employers to provide itemized wage statements.

records.label: Employment Contracts / Offer Letters
records.acquisition_pathway: Request copies of all signed employment agreements, offer letters, and amendments.

records.label: Timesheets / Time Records
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from employer. FLSA requires employers to maintain time records for 2 years.

records.label: W-2 / 1099 Tax Forms
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from employer. If unavailable, request wage and income transcript from IRS (Form 4506-T).

records.label: Employee Handbook / Policy Manual
records.acquisition_pathway: Request current and historical versions of the employee handbook from HR.

records.label: DOL Complaint / Investigation Records
records.custodian: US Department of Labor / State labor agency
records.acquisition_pathway: File FOIA request with DOL for investigation records. State records available through state public records request.

records.label: Foster Care Placement Records
records.legal_basis: Party to case; Fostering Connections Act
records.acquisition_pathway: Request as a party to the case. Former foster youth have right to their own records.

records.label: Dependency Court Filings
records.acquisition_pathway: Request as a party to the dependency case. Non-parties may need court order.

records.label: School Records
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from the school district as parent/guardian. FERPA requires response within 45 days.

records.label: Case Plan / Service Plan Documents
records.legal_basis: Party to case; Title IV-E requirements
records.acquisition_pathway: Request as a party to the case. Parents are entitled to copies of the case plan.

records.label: Debt Validation Letter
records.acquisition_pathway: Send written validation request within 30 days of first contact. Collector must cease collection until validated.

records.label: Original Credit Agreement
records.acquisition_pathway: Request as part of debt validation. Collector must provide or identify the original creditor.

records.label: Payment History
records.acquisition_pathway: Request complete payment history as part of debt validation.

records.label: Collection Call Logs
records.acquisition_pathway: Maintain your own log of all collection calls: date, time, caller ID, what was said. Record calls if permitted by state law.

records.label: Credit Reports
records.acquisition_pathway: Request free annual reports at annualcreditreport.com. Additional free reports available if adverse action taken.

records.label: Court Judgment Records
records.acquisition_pathway: Search court records by party name. Request certified copies from the clerk.

records.label: Guardianship Court Orders
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from probate court clerk. Interested parties have right of access.

records.label: Guardian Financial Reports / Accountings
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from probate court. Guardians are typically required to file annual accountings.

records.label: Ward's Medical Records
records.acquisition_pathway: Request as interested party or through court order if guardian is blocking access.

records.label: Guardian Care Plans
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from probate court. Many states require guardians to file care plans.

records.label: Court Visitor / Guardian ad Litem Reports
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from probate court. These are filed as part of the guardianship case record.

records.label: Ward's Bank Statements
records.acquisition_pathway: May require court order if guardian is blocking access. File motion with probate court.

records.label: APS Investigation Records
records.legal_basis: State disclosure statutes; subject of investigation
records.acquisition_pathway: Request as subject or interested party. Access varies significantly by state.

records.label: Nursing Home Inspection Reports
records.legal_basis: Public record; CMS Nursing Home Compare
records.acquisition_pathway: Search CMS Nursing Home Compare (medicare.gov/care-compare) for recent inspections. Request full reports from state health department.

records.label: Financial Records (Elder)
records.acquisition_pathway: Request as account holder or through power of attorney. May require court order if exploitation suspected.

records.label: Care Facility Complaint Logs
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from state health department or LTC ombudsman program.

records.label: Ombudsman Reports
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from the LTC ombudsman program. Some reports are public; individual case details may be restricted.

records.label: ICE Detention Records
records.acquisition_pathway: File FOIA/Privacy Act request with ICE FOIA office. Include A-number if known.

records.label: Immigration Court Filings
records.acquisition_pathway: Request as respondent or attorney of record. Non-parties file FOIA with EOIR.

records.label: ORR Placement Records (Unaccompanied Children)
records.acquisition_pathway: Request through attorney of record or file Privacy Act request with ORR.

records.label: Asylum Application (I-589) and Supporting Documents
records.acquisition_pathway: Request copies from USCIS or EOIR as the applicant or attorney of record.

records.label: Consular Records
records.custodian: US Department of State / foreign consulate
records.acquisition_pathway: File FOIA with State Department. Contact foreign consulate for consular access assistance.

records.label: CBP Encounter / Processing Records
records.acquisition_pathway: File FOIA/Privacy Act request with CBP FOIA office. Include any known encounter numbers.

records.label: Psychiatric Hold Records / Commitment Petitions
records.custodian: Hospital records department; county court clerk
records.legal_basis: HIPAA right of access; state mental health records acts
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from the facility that initiated the hold. Include dates of admission. If a court hearing occurred, request hearing transcripts from the county court clerk.

records.label: Commitment Hearing Transcripts / Court Orders
records.legal_basis: Court records access; state mental health code
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from the court that conducted the commitment hearing. May be sealed — file motion to unseal if necessary. Include case number and approximate hearing dates.

records.label: Psychiatric Treatment Records
records.legal_basis: HIPAA right of access (45 CFR § 164.524); state medical records acts
records.acquisition_pathway: Submit written request to the facility's health information management department. Federal law requires response within 30 days. If denied, file complaint with HHS Office for Civil Rights.

records.label: Medication Administration Records (MAR)
records.custodian: Hospital or facility pharmacy; nursing records
records.legal_basis: HIPAA right of access; state pharmacy acts
records.acquisition_pathway: Request as part of complete medical record. MAR shows every medication administered, dose, time, and route. Critical for polypharmacy cases — request the full MAR for entire stay.

records.label: Restraint & Seclusion Logs / Incident Reports
records.legal_basis: CMS Conditions of Participation (42 CFR § 482.13); HIPAA; state incident reporting laws
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from facility. Federal law requires facilities to document every restraint/seclusion episode including duration, type, physician order, and patient monitoring. If facility refuses, file complaint with CMS state survey agency.

records.label: Discharge Summary / Aftercare Plan
records.legal_basis: HIPAA right of access; CMS Conditions of Participation
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from the discharging facility. Should include diagnosis at discharge, medications prescribed, follow-up appointments scheduled, and aftercare instructions. If no discharge plan exists, that absence is itself evidence.

records.label: Patient Rights Notices / Acknowledgment Forms
records.legal_basis: CMS Conditions of Participation; state patient rights statutes
records.acquisition_pathway: Request from facility. Every psychiatric facility must provide written notice of patient rights at admission. If no signed acknowledgment exists, the facility may have failed its legal obligation.

records.label: Medical Record Amendment Request / Response History
records.acquisition_pathway: Submit formal amendment request in writing. Facility must respond within 60 days. If denied, you have the right to submit a statement of disagreement that must be included in your record permanently. If facility fails to respond, file complaint with HHS OCR.

records.label: Prescriber Notes / Medication Orders
records.legal_basis: HIPAA Right of Access (45 CFR § 164.524); state medical records laws
records.description: Notes from prescribing physicians documenting medication decisions, dosage changes, and clinical rationale.
records.acquisition_pathway: HIPAA Right of Access request to custodian

records.label: Pharmacy Dispensing Records
records.legal_basis: HIPAA Right of Access; state pharmacy practice acts
records.description: Complete dispensing history including all medications filled, dates, quantities, and any pharmacist interventions or flags.
records.acquisition_pathway: HIPAA Right of Access request to custodian

records.label: Adverse Event / Side Effect Reports
records.legal_basis: HIPAA Right of Access; FDA FOIA
records.description: Reports of adverse drug reactions, side effects, and medication-related incidents filed with the facility or FDA.
records.acquisition_pathway: HIPAA Right of Access request to custodian

records.label: Discharge Plan / Aftercare Plan
records.legal_basis: HIPAA Right of Access; CMS Conditions of Participation (42 CFR § 482.43)
records.description: The written plan created before discharge specifying follow-up appointments, medications, housing, and support services.
records.acquisition_pathway: HIPAA Right of Access request to custodian

records.label: Aftercare Referral Documentation
records.legal_basis: HIPAA Right of Access; state continuity of care laws
records.description: Documentation of referrals made to outpatient providers, community mental health centers, and support services.
records.acquisition_pathway: HIPAA Right of Access request to custodian

records.label: HIPAA Authorization / Release Forms
records.description: Signed authorization forms permitting or restricting disclosure of protected health information to family members.
records.acquisition_pathway: HIPAA Right of Access request to custodian

records.label: Visitor Logs / Access Records
records.legal_basis: Facility policy; state patient rights statutes
records.description: Records of who visited the patient, when visits were permitted or denied, and any restrictions placed on visitation.
records.acquisition_pathway: HIPAA Right of Access request to custodian

records.label: Patient Communication Records
records.legal_basis: State patient rights laws; facility policies
records.description: Records of phone calls, mail, and other communications permitted or restricted during treatment.
records.acquisition_pathway: HIPAA Right of Access request to custodian

records.label: Incident Reports / Use of Force Reports
records.legal_basis: HIPAA Right of Access; state incident reporting requirements; CMS Conditions of Participation
records.description: Internal reports documenting incidents of restraint, seclusion, injury, or other critical events.
records.acquisition_pathway: HIPAA Right of Access request to custodian

records.label: Staff Training / Certification Records
records.legal_basis: State FOIA; CMS Conditions of Participation
records.description: Records of staff training in de-escalation, restraint procedures, and patient rights — relevant to whether proper protocols were followed.
records.acquisition_pathway: HIPAA Right of Access request to custodian

records.label: Complete Medical Record
records.description: The entire designated record set including all notes, orders, test results, and correspondence related to the patient's care.
records.acquisition_pathway: HIPAA Right of Access request to custodian

records.label: Previous Amendment Request Responses
records.description: Responses to any previous requests to amend the medical record, including denials and the stated reasons.
records.acquisition_pathway: HIPAA Right of Access request to custodian

records.label: Re Tribal Housing Authority Records
records.description: Record: re tribal housing authority records

records.label: Re Use Of Force Reports
records.description: Record: re use of force reports
